dogecoin.text: @BillyM2k I'm a fan of Dogecoin.  Why do they go down in the past and elon post they go up again?  Why doesn't anyone think they support Dogecoin themselves without elon?

War starts → crypto crashes.
Peace returns → crypto climbs.

Sounds like a strategy:
“Sell in war, buy in peace.”
